scientific_integrity: The threshold and covariance formulas are analytic claims with independent rational check code; finite checks are supporting diagnostics. Earlier special-case overlap is possible and independent validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only two normalized SPD coordinates, one-step remote-only delay, uniform independent single-coordinate updates, constant relaxation, independent zero-mean finite-variance additive noise, and exact arithmetic. The theorem addresses mean-square stability and limiting second moments, not wall-clock performance or arbitrary dimensions.
title: Sharp stale-coordinate stability and stationary-noise crossover in randomized two-variable relaxation
